instructor.name: Cal Morgan
instructor.direction: Speak clear English as an experienced flight instructor. Warm, patient and engaged, with natural changes in pitch and clear emphasis on the important actions. Use conversational sentence pauses.

rosa.name: Rosa Vance
rosa.role: Private pilot checkride examiner (named in L4)
rosa.direction: Speak clear English as a composed checkride examiner. Attentive, assured and professional. Give the first alert a brief lift in energy, then make the corrective instruction calm and clear. Use natural expressive intonation.

tower.name: Ellis Park
tower.direction: Clear native English pronunciation, role-specific pacing and sentence pauses. Text punctuation and speed control are used; no acting prompt is passed to this renderer.

spectre.name: Finn Mercer
spectre.direction: Speak clear American English as a friendly display pilot. Upbeat, confident and animated, with warm praise, lively pitch variation and a conversational rhythm.

aster.name: Aster
aster.direction: Clear native English pronunciation, role-specific pacing and sentence pauses. Text punctuation and speed control are used; no acting prompt is passed to this renderer.

nyx.name: Nyx
nyx.role: XR-9 / XR-11 research and tactical computer
nyx.direction: Clear native English pronunciation, role-specific pacing and sentence pauses. Text punctuation and speed control are used; no acting prompt is passed to this renderer.

tower_north.name: North Tower
tower_north.direction: Clear, composed American male controller, concise pacing; native preset and punctuation, no acting prompt.

tower_coast.name: Coast Tower
tower_coast.direction: Clear American female controller with a steady delivery; native preset and punctuation, no acting prompt.

tower_valley.name: Valley Tower
tower_valley.direction: Measured British male controller; native preset and punctuation, no acting prompt. Uses the same generic game phrase library.

radio.description: External VHF-style radio into a pilot headset

cockpit.description: Aircraft computer routed to the pilot headset

headset_filter.squelch: external radio full lines only; fragments omit per-piece squelch
headset_filter.playback_instruction: Use audio as supplied; apply no second headset filter. masters retains only basic 70 Hz cleanup, gain and fades before headset treatment.

notes: Standalone spoken letter names; no key suffix and no NATO phonetic substitutions.
Uppercase and lowercase resolve to the same letter sound.
Z is zed for declared en-gb roles and zee for en-us roles.
All existing character presets and headset channels are preserved.

line_up_wait.condition: runway entry authorized and landing/takeoff conflict checks satisfied

takeoff_clearance.condition: takeoff authorization granted for this runway and aircraft; runway clear

landing_clearance.condition: landing authorization granted for this runway and aircraft; runway separation satisfied

left_downwind.condition: left circuit assigned and safe route

right_downwind.condition: right circuit assigned and safe route

straight_in.condition: straight-in approach assigned and terrain/traffic route valid

wind_gusting.condition: actual gust exceeds actual sustained wind

departure_frequency.condition: active departure frequency modeled and handoff authorized

taxi.condition: actual cleared taxi route provided; runway crossings require separate authorizations

integration.station_voice_policy: Assign one tower voice to an airport and keep it for the whole exchange; do not reroll each utterance.
integration.guidance_policy: Play clearance/instruction only after the corresponding modeled ATC state decision; never choose procedural instructions as random ambient chatter.
integration.priority: Go-around/emergency > runway conflict > clearance > sequencing/weather > greeting
integration.squelch: Fragments have no per-piece squelch. Add one boundary cue to a complete radio transmission.
integration.claims: Assets and resolver only; no game branch changes or implemented ATC decision engine.
